speaker: Unknown
en: So collectively, the costs were significantly reduced.
zh: 所以总体上,成本会显著降低。

speaker: Unknown
en: Therefore, we can run the highest intelligence model much more ubiquitously in the future, but we don't have a system designing for that.
zh: 因此,未来我们可以更普遍地运行最高智能的模型,但我们还没有为此设计的系统。

speaker: Unknown
en: For example, we don't have a great system designed for 10 trillion parameter models today.
zh: 比如说,今天我们还没有一个为 10 万亿参数模型设计的很好的系统。

speaker: Unknown
en: That will require very smart engineering co-design from the model to the customization serving platform layer all the way to chip layer.
zh: 这将需要非常聪明的工程协同设计,从模型到定制化服务平台层,一直到芯片层。

speaker: Unknown
en: The chip is not the individual chip but the system, collection of chips in system and all as a total package.
zh: 芯片不是单个芯片,而是系统,是系统中芯片的集合,以及所有作为一个整体包。

speaker: Unknown
en: I think there's still a lot of innovation we can do.
zh: 我认为我们仍然可以做很多创新。

speaker: Unknown
en: I think recently you announced that you were at 800 million in ARR.
zh: 我记得最近你们宣布 ARR 达到了 8 亿美元。

speaker: Unknown
en: Incredible feat and scaled so fast.
zh: 非凡的成就,而且增长得这么快。

speaker: Unknown
en: What is that at the end of this year?
zh: 到今年年底会达到多少?

speaker: Unknown
en: We think we can at least double.
zh: 我们认为我们至少能翻倍。

speaker: Unknown
en: By the end of the year.
zh: 到今年年底。

speaker: Unknown
en: Wow.
zh: 哇。

speaker: Unknown
en: You know what's so interesting for me as a venture investor?
zh: 你知道,作为一个风险投资人,什么让我觉得特别有意思?

speaker: Unknown
en: I've been investing for 10 years.
zh: 我做投资已经 10 年了。

speaker: Unknown
en: We used to be in the day where Slack was the golden child, where like 1 to 10 million in revenue in 18 months was like amazing.
zh: 我们曾经处在 Slack 是 golden child 的时代,18 个月内从 100 万做到 1000 万收入就已经是了不起的了。

speaker: Unknown
en: And now we have companies like Fireworks, where you scale to 800 million in revenue in a matter of years.
zh: 而现在我们有像 Fireworks 这样的公司,在短短几年内规模做到 8 亿美元收入。

speaker: Unknown
en: And you mentioned Cursor, scaling to billions in revenue in a matter of years.
zh: 而且你提到 Cursor,在短短几年内规模做到数十亿美元收入。

speaker: Unknown
en: The speed of company revenue growth is just unparalleled.
zh: 公司收入增长的速度是无可比拟的。

speaker: Unknown
en: I think it's because there's a fundamental disruption in this technology that is all empowering.
zh: 我认为这是因为这项技术存在根本性的颠覆,它赋予了所有人能力。

speaker: Unknown
en: All empowering in a sense it reach out to every individual one of us to be creative.
zh: 赋能所有人,从某种意义上说,它触及到我们每一个人,让我们都能去创造。

speaker: Unknown
en: And it unleashed a lot of creativity that we just don't have access to.
zh: 它释放了大量我们之前无法触及的创造力。

speaker: Unknown
en: And that's why we're seeing this phenomenon of extremely fast growth because of a demand.
zh: 这就是为什么我们看到这种极速增长的现象,因为需求。

speaker: Unknown
en: Final one before we do a quick fire.
zh: 在快速问答之前,最后一个问题。

speaker: Unknown
en: You hired George Hu, who was president of Salesforce.
zh: 你聘用了 George Hu,他曾是 Salesforce 的总裁。

speaker: Unknown
en: He's exceptional.
zh: 他非常出色。

speaker: Unknown
en: He's one of the most direct, no BS operators I've ever met.
zh: 他是我见过的最直接、不废话的运营者之一。

speaker: Unknown
en: But you met him a couple of years before or a year before and you were like, oh, we're not ready for you yet.
zh: 但你在一两年前就见过他,当时你说:哦,我们还没准备好要你。

speaker: Unknown
en: Why did you say that?
zh: 你为什么这么说?

speaker: Unknown
en: And why did you decide now was the time?
zh: 而你为什么决定现在正是时候?

speaker: Unknown
en: So a year ago, I think we were probably just 50 people.
zh: 一年前,我想我们大概只有 50 个人。

speaker: Unknown
en: So today we're at 200 people.
zh: 而今天我们达到 200 人。

speaker: Unknown
en: We're still not that big.
zh: 我们仍然不算大。

speaker: Unknown
en: Wow, you're 4 million ahead.
zh: 哇,你领先了 400 万。

speaker: Unknown
en: At 50 people, I'm more thinking about scaling the product first than scaling massively scale the business.
zh: 在 50 人的时候,我更多考虑的是先把产品规模化,而不是大规模地扩张业务。

speaker: Unknown
en: And we talked and I have huge respect to him.
zh: 我们聊过,而且我对他非常尊敬。

speaker: Unknown
en: I know he's legendary.
zh: 我知道他是传奇人物。

speaker: Unknown
en: He's a legendary operator in Silicon Valley.
zh: 他是硅谷传奇的运营者。

speaker: Unknown
en: I just feel like we're too small for him.
zh: 我只是觉得,对他来说我们太小了。

speaker: Unknown
en: And I told him that, hey, we're probably too small for you, but I would like to work with you at some capacity.
zh: 我告诉了他,嘿,对你来说我们可能太小了,但我希望以后能以某种方式与你共事。

speaker: Unknown
en: So he helped me actually build up the team, interview a lot of executives.
zh: 所以他实际上帮我组建了团队,面试了很多高管。

speaker: Unknown
en: His feedback is always well-balanced, very thoughtful.
zh: 他的反馈总是很平衡，非常周到。

speaker: Unknown
en: And we start to work together in that capacity.
zh: 于是我们开始以那种身份合作。

speaker: Unknown
en: And to, I think, end of last year, we're growing really fast.
zh: 然后，我想是去年年底，我们增长得非常快。

speaker: Unknown
en: And he knows.
zh: 他知道这一点。

speaker: Unknown
en: And we start talking seriously.
zh: 我们开始认真地谈。

speaker: Unknown
en: And that early relationship paid off.
zh: 那段早期的关系得到了回报。

speaker: Unknown
en: He's really cool in the sense that he did a lot of things, a great accomplishment in the past.
zh: 他真的很棒，因为他做过很多事，过去有很了不起的成就。

speaker: Unknown
en: I find a unique character about him is he's extremely experienced, has high altitude of business vision, but he is also very curious.
zh: 我发现他一个独特的特质是，他极其有经验，有很高的商业视野高度，但他同时也非常好奇。

speaker: Unknown
en: He doesn't make assumptions.
zh: 他不做假设。

speaker: Unknown
en: I know it all.
zh: 我全都知道。

speaker: Unknown
en: I've seen all the movies.
zh: 我看过所有的电影。

speaker: Unknown
en: It's the same movie.
zh: 都是同一部电影。

speaker: Unknown
en: And let me just kind of direct this movie as I did in the past.
zh: 让我就像过去那样来导演这部电影吧。

speaker: Unknown
en: So he didn't come with that attitude.
zh: 所以他没有带着那种态度来。

speaker: Unknown
en: He knows AI goes in insanely fast pace, learning a long way, but also
zh: 他知道 AI 以疯狂的速度前进，还有很长的路要学，但同时

speaker: Unknown
en: Full embrace AI.
zh: 完全拥抱 AI。

speaker: Unknown
en: Actually, his team, our GTM team is using all kind of AI agents.
zh: 实际上，他的团队，我们的 GTM 团队在使用各种各样的 AI 智能体。

speaker: Unknown
en: They're sharing skills.
zh: 他们在分享 skills。

speaker: Unknown
en: So they maximize their productivity.
zh: 这样他们把生产力最大化。

speaker: Unknown
en: And he knows we have a super linear demand curve.
zh: 而且他知道我们的需求曲线是超线性的。

speaker: Unknown
en: There is just certain pace we can build our GTM team.
zh: 我们建设 GTM 团队的速度是有限的。

speaker: Unknown
en: In order for us to catch this curve, we need to build our team, but the team need to also have increasing productivity to match.
zh: 为了跟上这条曲线，我们需要建设团队，但团队也必须拥有不断提高的生产力来匹配。

speaker: Unknown
en: So that's a problem he's solving, and I feel very fortunate to work with him.
zh: 所以这就是他在解决的问题，能和他共事我感到非常幸运。

speaker: Unknown
en: In general, I feel in the AI space, the unique part is people need to have very special traits, almost like contradictory characteristics.
zh: 总的来说，我觉得在 AI 领域，独特之处在于人们需要拥有非常特殊的特质，几乎像是矛盾的品格。

speaker: Unknown
en: For example, very experienced but super curious in the fast learning curve.
zh: 比如，非常有经验但又超级好奇，处于快速的学习曲线上。

speaker: Unknown
en: Or Dima, we talked a little bit earlier, he is brilliant, high intellectual horsepower, but extremely humble.
zh: 或者 Dima，我们前面聊到过一点，他非常聪明，智力马力很高，但又极其谦逊。

speaker: Unknown
en: It's a weird combination.
zh: 这是一种奇怪的组合。

speaker: Unknown
en: And he's almost like cynical in an Eastern European way, but also at the same time very humble.
zh: 他几乎像是以东欧式的愤世嫉俗，但同时又非常谦逊。

speaker: Unknown
en: Can I do a quickfire album?
zh: 我能来一个快问快答专辑吗？

speaker: Unknown
en: OK, let's do it.
zh: 好，我们开始吧。

speaker: Unknown
en: OK, what have you changed your mind on most in the last 12 months?
zh: 好，过去 12 个月里你在什么问题上改变想法最多？

speaker: Unknown
en: I think how fast we grow, I changed my mind because I have been quite worried about too big a team too early.
zh: 我觉得是关于我们增长多快，我改变了想法，因为我一直很担心太早拥有太大的团队。

speaker: Unknown
en: So that's why when I met George, I told him, we're too small for you because I don't intend to grow very fast in terms of people.
zh: 所以我遇到 George 的时候，我告诉他，对你来说我们太小了，因为我不打算在人员上增长得很快。

speaker: Unknown
en: I worry about getting slowed down and lose agility and velocity very deeply.
zh: 我非常深切地担心被拖慢，失去敏捷性和速度。

speaker: Unknown
en: But since then, we have been very aggressively using AIR tools.
zh: 但从那以后，我们一直在非常激进地使用 AIR 工具。

speaker: Unknown
en: We have developed our own unique way of hiring certain type of people.
zh: 我们发展出了自己独特的方式来招聘某一类人。

speaker: Unknown
en: That we know they will be charging forward with high velocity as extreme sense of ownership, very communicative, and never take no as an answer.
zh: 我们知道他们会以极高的速度冲锋，有极强的主人翁意识，非常善于沟通，并且从不接受「不」这个答案。

speaker: Unknown
en: So we also learn how to get those people.
zh: 所以我们也学会了如何招到这些人。

speaker: Unknown
en: And now I feel much more comfortable skating really fast.
zh: 现在我对滑得非常快感到自在多了。

speaker: Unknown
en: What's your type of people?
zh: 你们的那类人是什么样的？

speaker: Unknown
en: And I know that sounds weird, but our type of people is actually really specific.
zh: 我知道这听起来很怪，但我们那类人其实非常具体。

speaker: Unknown
en: Pretty much only hire immigrants.
zh: 基本上只招移民。

speaker: Unknown
en: British people don't work very hard.
zh: 英国人工作不够努力。

speaker: Unknown
en: Sorry.
zh: 抱歉。

speaker: Unknown
en: Very scientific and rigorous.
zh: 非常科学、严谨。

speaker: Unknown
en: Use data for most things.
zh: 大多数事情都用数据。

speaker: Unknown
en: I actually think creativity often comes from data and is informed by data.
zh: 我实际上认为创造力往往来自数据，并由数据提供依据。

speaker: Unknown
en: And unwaveringly accountable and ownership.
zh: 还有毫不动摇的担当和主人翁意识。

speaker: Unknown
en: Nothing is anyone else's fault.
zh: 没有什么是别人的错。

speaker: Unknown
en: It's all my fault.
zh: 都是我的错。

speaker: Unknown
en: Even if it's someone else's fault.
zh: 即使那是别人的错。

speaker: Unknown
en: That's a 20 VC person.
zh: 那是 20 个 VC 人的。

speaker: Unknown
en: What would you say yours is?
zh: 你会说你自己的是什么?

speaker: Unknown
en: In a weird way, it's not competence.
zh: 说来奇怪,不是能力。

speaker: Unknown
en: We want people with the high competence, but more importantly, the strong indicator whether they will do well in this wave, especially in fireworks, is whether they are really built for taking extreme ownership.
zh: 我们想要能力很高的人,但更重要的是,判断他们能否在这一波浪潮中表现出色——尤其是在 fireworks——最强的指标是他们是否真正具备承担极致所有权的特质。

speaker: Unknown
en: Extreme ownership as in we are not putting people anywhere in any boxes and we're just stacking the box together into a tower.
zh: 极致所有权指的是,我们不把人放在任何框框里,我们只是把盒子堆叠成一座塔。

speaker: Unknown
en: People just automatically claim, hey, this is an end-to-end problem, I'm going to see through the whole thing and work with a bunch of people to make it happen and I'm going to deliver it no matter what.
zh: 人们会自动认领:嘿,这是一个端到端的问题,我要把整件事看透,和一群人一起把它做成,并且无论如何我都要交付。

speaker: Unknown
en: So those kind of people have the highest, longest mileage and their growth curve is amazing also.
zh: 所以这类人有最高的、最长的续航里程,他们的成长曲线也非常惊人。

speaker: Unknown
en: What's your biggest lesson from working with Jensen Huang on what makes him so special?
zh: 和 Jensen Huang 共事,关于他为什么如此特别,你最大的收获是什么?

speaker: Unknown
en: He's everywhere.
zh: 他无处不在。

speaker: Unknown
en: I seriously think he has a clone of like hundreds of Jensen somehow plugging.
zh: 我真的觉得他有几百个 Jensen 的克隆,不知怎么地同时在线。

speaker: Unknown
en: For example, I sent him an email.
zh: 举例来说,我给他发一封邮件。

speaker: Unknown
en: He will reply in one minute.
zh: 他会一分钟内回复。

speaker: Unknown
en: I just don't understand how he's like constantly in details.
zh: 我就是无法理解他怎么能一直深入在细节里。

speaker: Unknown
en: But now I operate a company for four years.
zh: 但现在我自己运营公司四年了。

speaker: Unknown
en: I understand why he's doing that is that defines velocity.
zh: 我明白他为什么这么做,那就是定义速度。

speaker: Unknown
en: Because what is leadership?
zh: 因为什么是领导力?

speaker: Unknown
en: Leadership is just judgment.
zh: 领导力就是判断力。

speaker: Unknown
en: It's not privilege.
zh: 不是特权。

speaker: Unknown
en: It's judgment.
zh: 是判断力。

speaker: Unknown
en: You basically have the context.
zh: 你基本上要掌握上下文。

speaker: Unknown
en: You need to have the right context to make the right judgment for the team.
zh: 你需要掌握正确的上下文,才能为团队做出正确的判断。

speaker: Unknown
en: And especially in a high velocity space, if you do not know what's happening, what works, what doesn't work, what are the gaps, you make the wrong call.
zh: 尤其在一个高速度的领域,如果你不知道正在发生什么、什么有效、什么无效、差距在哪里,你就会做出错误的决策。

speaker: Unknown
en: In a slow moving space, you can wait for the cascading information up and down and make those calls.
zh: 在一个缓慢变动的领域,你可以等待信息层层上下传递,再做那些决策。

speaker: Unknown
en: But in a fast iteration space, you just cannot wait because it's guaranteed there is information loss in transition.
zh: 但在一个快速迭代的领域,你就是不能等,因为信息在传递过程中必然会有损失。

speaker: Unknown
en: Layer after layer, people after people, it always happens.
zh: 一层又一层,一个人又一个人,这总是会发生。

speaker: Unknown
en: And not knowing what exactly is happening and having the precision of make judgment makes bad leadership.
zh: 而不清楚究竟在发生什么、做判断缺乏精确性,就会导致糟糕的领导力。

speaker: Unknown
en: He is demonstrated through his own example, even before this crazy AI thing, he's operating that way.
zh: 他用自己的亲身示范了这一点,甚至在这疯狂的 AI 浪潮之前,他就是那样运营的。

speaker: Unknown
en: And before I was admiring him in his sheer amount of volume of capability of doing that, now I understand the wisdom behind that because I also operate that way.
zh: 以前我钦佩的是他能做到这一切的巨大工作量,现在我理解了背后的智慧,因为我自己也是那样运营的。

speaker: Unknown
en: I need to know what's happening on the ground to make the judgment for the company.
zh: 我需要知道一线正在发生什么,才能为公司做出判断。

speaker: Unknown
en: What did you wait on in the fireworks journey that you wish you hadn't waited on?
zh: 在 fireworks 的历程中,有什么是你等了、但希望当初没等的?

speaker: Unknown
en: Marketing.
zh: 市场营销。

speaker: Unknown
en: We talk about it.
zh: 我们谈过这个。

speaker: Unknown
en: So we are a little bit nerdy in this way.
zh: 我们在这方面有点书呆子气。

speaker: Unknown
en: At the very beginning of our journey, we didn't discuss it, but we feel product will speak for itself.
zh: 在我们旅程的最开始,我们没有讨论过它,但我们觉得产品自己会说话。

speaker: Unknown
en: At the end, product stands.
zh: 归根结底,产品才是立得住的。

speaker: Unknown
en: And we want to devote all our effort and focus on building product, work with the customer, validate product market fit, and go from there.
zh: 我们没有优先去教育我们的客户,关于这个趋势和价值,什么是正确的思考方向。

speaker: Unknown
en: And we didn't spend much time marketing at all.
zh: 我们几乎没有在市场营销上花时间。

speaker: Unknown
en: We didn't prioritize educating our customer what's the right direction to think about the trend and the value.
zh: 我们没有把精力放在教育客户上,让他们了解什么是思考这个趋势和价值的正确方向。

speaker: Unknown
en: But we do think now, I do think it's important.
zh: 但我们现在觉得,我现在觉得这很重要。

speaker: Unknown
en: Marketing is not about flows.
zh: 市场营销不是关于流量。

speaker: Unknown
en: It's more about education.
zh: 它更多是关于教育。

speaker: Unknown
en: It's more about clarity.
zh: 它更多是关于清晰。

speaker: Unknown
en: And we are working on that.
zh: 而我们正在这方面努力。

speaker: Unknown
en: What area of AI is underinvested in today in your mind?
zh: 在你看来,如今 AI 的哪个领域投资不足?

speaker: Unknown
en: You mentioned like cooling or servers.
zh: 你提到过像冷却或服务器。

speaker: Unknown
en: What area is like underinvested in?
zh: 哪个领域是投资不足的?

speaker: Unknown
en: AI has the sexy part of this is such innovative, creative technology, and build something on top of it is the focus.
zh: AI 有性感的一面,这是如此创新、有创造力的技术,在它之上构建东西是焦点。

speaker: Unknown
en: But monitoring the ROI, I think the industry started to kind of pay attention to it.
zh: 但监控 ROI,我认为行业开始有点注意到它了。

speaker: Unknown
en: But eventually, that's what matters.
zh: 但归根结底,那才是真正重要的。

speaker: Unknown
en: Not how much spend is, what is the return, and what is the cost, and what is the attribution.
zh: 不是花了多少钱,而是回报是什么,成本是什么,归因是什么。

speaker: Unknown
en: In the next couple of years, as AI is getting more and more into production, there will be a lot of focus in getting that clarity and getting that discipline out.
zh: 在接下来几年里,随着 AI 越来越多地进入生产环境,会有很多精力放在获得这种清晰度和这种纪律上。

speaker: Unknown
en: The token maxing is just a thing in time, but we're quickly moving to ROI maxing, which is all about running a business.
zh: 因为有一个与软件的类比:每家公司都构建自己的软件栈是有原因的。

speaker: Unknown
en: What large customer do you not have that you would most like to have?
zh: 你现在还没有的、最想拥有的大型客户是谁?

speaker: Unknown
en: So we haven't spent too much time in traditional enterprise segment.
zh: 我们没有在传统企业客群上花太多时间。

speaker: Unknown
en: I think that's just because we were very small.
zh: 我想那只是因为我们当时非常小。

speaker: Unknown
en: And now as we build out our company, I do think even without us investing, we have customers like Geico, like Capital One, all these companies.
zh: 而现在随着我们把公司建设起来,我确实认为,即使我们没有去投入,我们也有像 Geico、像 Capital One 这样的客户,所有这些公司。

speaker: Unknown
en: So even without us pursuing enterprise, traditional enterprise, they come to us.
zh: 所以即使我们没有去追求企业客户、传统企业客户,他们也会来找我们。

speaker: Unknown
en: But I do think that's a very big market.
zh: 但我确实认为那是一个非常大的市场。
